pr_272_selected_issue_comments.author: ktogias
pr_272_selected_issue_comments.body:
### Fresh-review finding disposition — shell-wrapper bypass

**Finding:** valid. CodeRabbit, Qodo, and CodeAnt independently identified the same gap on exact head `183b5948426bf8e074156a50c6b20ce05dec6c54`: the direct-Ruff regex recognizes a command only at line start or after `;`, `&`, or `|`, and the scan is limited to the compatibility job.

**Evidence:** the exact expression returns true for `python -m ruff check .`, but false for each of `if python -m ruff check .; then …`, `! ruff format --check .`, `command ruff check .`, and `env FOO=bar python -m ruff check .`. Those differently named steps would leave the contract green.

**Proposed fix:** remove the shell-shape heuristic. Keep the exact compatibility shared-gate assertions, then inspect every `run` block in every job of the ordinary verification workflow and fail if its text contains `ruff` case-insensitively. The authorized `./ci/style --check` command contains no Ruff literal, so this establishes an intentionally strict, shell-wrapper-independent single entry point. Add explicit synthetic wrapper cases demonstrating the marker catches the reported forms. Then rerun exact-head local verification, provider CI, and all fresh reviewers. No merge will be performed.
